channel.title: Epic Fury Live — US-Iran War Tracker
channel.description: Live tracking of the US-Israel-Iran conflict. Real-time updates, verified casualties, evidence, and analysis.

item.title: Qatar on mediation efforts: ‘We can’t let diplomacy fail’
item.description: Qatar’s Majed al-Ansari says Doha is determined to make diplomacy work to end the US-Iran conflict.

item.title: Powerful El Nino could cause more than 450,000 deaths, scientists say
item.description: Heaviest toll expected in poorer countries, already struggling with food insecurity and high energy costs, report says.

item.title: Yemen government forces claim control of Mount Qarfan in Taiz
item.description: Major General Abdulaziz al-Majidi says five Houthi fighters killed and 20 wounded after 'fierce battles'.

item.title: ‘Annihilate’ vs ‘crushing’ attacks: Why Iran, US up rhetoric amid talks
item.description: Trump threatens to 'annihilate' Iran and then brags about diplomacy, provoking Tehran to warn of a response.

item.title: At least 11 people killed in South Africa township shooting
item.description: Armed men open fire at a house party in a Durban township, killing a pregnant woman and 10 others.

item.title: US, Iran hold mediated UNGA talks on ending war, opening Strait of Hormuz
item.description: Tehran ties diplomatic progress to lifting shipping blockades and unfreezing assets during New York negotiations.

item.title: Sri Lanka convicts 15 people over 2019 Easter Day bombings
item.description: Fifteen people have been convicted over Sri Lanka’s 2019 Easter Sunday bombings, which killed 279 people.

item.title: US and Iran hold first talks since June after Trump's 'annihilation' threat
item.description: The talks are the first since a ceasefire collapsed in June, with the sides exchanging fire intermittently.

item.title: Eleven killed in mass shooting at house in South Africa
item.description: One of those killed is believed to be a pregnant woman, police said.

item.title: How Ceuta, football and Israel are shaping Morocco's election
item.description: Young voters are being courted with football slogans, promises of jobs and anti-Israel rallying calls.
